rows.source_ko: 제54조의2(항만시설보안료의 징수요율 승인신청 등) ① 항만시설소유자는 법 제42조제3항에 따라 같은 조 제1항에 따른 항만시설보안료(이하 “항만시설보안료”라 한다)의 징수요율을 승인받거나 변경승인받으려는 경우에는 매년 1월 1일부터 4월 30일까지 별지 제28호서식에 따른 항만시설보안료 징수요율 승인(변경승인)신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 관할 지방해양수산청장에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 2017. 6. 2., 2020. 8. 19.>
rows.text_en: Article 54-2 (Application for Approval of Collection Rate for Port Facility Security Fees, etc.) ①In accordance with Article 42, Paragraph 3 of the Act , if an owner of a port facility intends to obtain approval for or obtain approval for a change in the collection rate of port facility security fees (hereinafter referred to as “port facility security fees”) pursuant to Paragraph 1 of the same Article, the owner shall submit an application for approval (or approval for change) of the collection rate of port facility security fees in accordance with Form No. 28 of the Annex, attached with the documents set forth in each of the following subparagraphs, to the head of the competent Regional Maritime Affairs and Fisheries Office from January 1 to April 30 of each year. <Amended June 2, 2017; August 19, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 1. 세금계산서(보안시설 및 장비를 구입한 경우만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 1. Tax invoice (applicable only to the purchase of security facilities and equipment)

rows.source_ko: 2. 계약서 사본(보안시설 및 장비를 구입하거나 경비인력 확보를 위하여 경비업체와 위탁계약을 체결한 경우만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 2. Copy of the contract (applicable only if a consignment contract has been entered into with a security company to purchase security facilities and equipment or to secure security personnel)

rows.source_ko: 3. 보수명세서 사본(경비인력을 직원으로 채용한 경우만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 3. Copy of remuneration statement (applicable only if security personnel are hired as employees)

rows.source_ko: 4. 항만시설보안료의 수지계산서
rows.text_en: 4. Income and Expense Statement for Port Facility Security Fees

rows.source_ko: 5. 항만시설보안료의 징수요율변경 전ㆍ후 대비표(징수요율을 변경하는 경우만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 5. Comparison table of port facility security fee collection rates before and after change (applicable only to cases where the collection rate is changed)

rows.source_ko: 6. 항만시설보안료 사용계획
rows.text_en: 6. Port Facility Security Fee Usage Plan

rows.source_ko: ② 지방해양수산청장은 제1항에 따른 항만시설보안료 징수요율 승인(변경승인)신청서를 접수한 때에는 법 제42조제4항에 따라 관계 중앙행정기관의 장과의 사전협의를 거쳐 30일 이내에 그 승인여부를 항만시설소유자에게 통보해야 한다. <개정 2017. 6. 2., 2020. 8. 19.>
rows.text_en: ② Upon receiving an application for approval (or approval for change) of the collection rate for port facility security fees pursuant to Paragraph 1, the Head of the Regional Maritime Affairs and Fisheries Office shall notify the owner of the port facility of whether or not such approval is granted within 30 days, following prior consultation with the heads of relevant central administrative agencies pursuant to Article 42, Paragraph 4 of the Act. <Amended June 2, 2017; August 19, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ③ 법 제42조제3항에 따라 승인받은 항만시설보안료의 징수요율은 승인받은 연도의 7월 1일부터 다음 연도의 6월 30일까지 적용한다. <신설 2020. 8. 19.>
rows.text_en: ③ The collection rate for port facility security fees approved pursuant to Article 42, Paragraph 3 of the Act shall apply from July 1 of the year of approval until June 30 of the following year. <Newly added Aug. 19, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ④ 항만시설소유자는 법 제42조제5항에 따른 해상화물운송사업자등(이하 “해상화물운송사업자등”이라 한다)이 같은 조 제6항에 따라 항만시설보안료를 한꺼번에 대신하여 납부한 경우에는 다음 각 호의 구분에 따라 대납업무에 드는 경비를 지급한다. <신설 2020. 8. 19.>
rows.text_en: ④ In cases where a maritime cargo transport business operator, etc. pursuant to Article 42 , Paragraph 5 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “maritime cargo transport business operator, etc.”) has paid the port facility security fees in a lump sum on behalf of the owner pursuant to Paragraph 6 of the same Article, the owner of the port facility shall pay the expenses incurred in the payment on behalf of the owner in accordance with the classifications in each of the following subparagraphs. <Newly added Aug. 19, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 1. 항만시설소유자가 국가 또는 시ㆍ도인 경우: 납부한 항만시설보안료 총액의 100분의 3에 해당하는 금액
rows.text_en: 1. Where the owner of the port facility is the State or a City/Province: An amount equivalent to 3% of the total port facility security fees paid.

rows.source_ko: 2. 항만시설소유자가 제1호 외의 자인 경우: 항만시설소유자와 해상화물운송사업자등이 협의하여 정하는 금액
rows.text_en: 2. Where the owner of the port facility is a person other than that specified in Subparagraph 1: An amount determined by consultation between the owner of the port facility and the maritime cargo transport business operator, etc.

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 제4항제1호에 따라 대납업무에 드는 경비를 지급받으려는 자는 「항만법」 제26조에 따른 항만물류통합정보체계를 이용하여 매월 지방해양수산청장 또는 시ㆍ도지사에게 경비를 청구해야 한다. <신설 2020. 8. 19.>
